records.name: Break the Iron Incursion
records.description: The Iron Captain is mapping our den. Break his command in the eastern incursion camp.
records.hint: Dodge the charge; strike after his sweep.

records.name: Silence the Rootvein Nest
records.description: Silk chokes the northern loop. Bring down the giant spider before its brood reaches Hearth Hall.
records.hint: Move out of venom and thin the spiderlings.

records.name: The Rider in the Hollow
records.description: A wolf rider circles the surface trail. Hunt it in the hollow, then follow the heat beneath its tracks.
records.hint: Dodge the pounce and watch the wolf pack.

records.name: Quench the Cinder Heart
records.destination: Thornwood Hollow → southern heat-crack → eastern kiln
records.description: The hollow cracks open onto a burning orchard. Cross the ash courts and extinguish Kilnheart in the eastern kiln.
records.hint: Find gaps between the cracks; use trunks against heat sweeps; strike the open heart.

records.name: Break the Shield Vanguard
records.description: The Shield Vanguard holds the overlook. Scatter the next human assault before it can march underground.
records.hint: Circle the shield and punish heavy attacks.

records.name: The Huntmaster in the Mire
records.description: Huntmaster Vane follows our footprints through the bog. End the hunt on our terms.
records.hint: Keep space to dodge; use your class special.

records.name: The Exiled Cave-Mouth Ogre
records.description: The old cave-mouth ogre has retreated to Frostroot. Defeat it there and investigate the sealed passage beyond.
records.hint: Step outside the smash before it lands.

records.name: Starve the Gilded Hunger
records.description: Light both wards on each upper floor. Descend to the royal vault and defeat the Gilded Hunger.
records.hint: Watch the maw and coin volleys. The reliquary and Rusk reward remain yours to claim.

records.name: The Paladin at Frostroot
records.description: Grand Paladin Aurelius comes for the relics beneath our home. Meet him at Frostroot before his army arrives.
records.hint: Prepare medicine and upgrades before this duel.

records.name: Keep the Fire Against the Dawn
records.description: The Dawn Hero has come to finish the expedition we interrupted. Defend the tribe and bring the last tale home.
records.hint: Use every upgrade and return to Moss after victory.

records.name: Cinder Orchard · The Last Ember
records.destination: FINAL BONUS · Thornwood Hollow → southern heat-crack → eastern kiln
records.description: The nine hunts are complete. One threat still burns beneath the hollow: the Cinder Orchard. Prepare your best equipment, upgrades, and medicine before challenging Kilnheart.
records.hint: Extreme danger. Dodge lethal vents and sweeping heat. Strike the exposed heart. Leaving the kiln for 2.5 seconds or leaving the Orchard restores Kilnheart.

records.name: Crown of the Northern Grove
records.destination: Thornwood Hollow → north gate → Approach → Shrine → Crown Glade
records.description: A new threat wears the hunters' collars. Follow the northern hollow into Thornveil and break the Bramble Crown.
records.hint: Sidestep the gore line, strafe across thorn volleys, keep moving through root snares, step inside the crown burst, and cut the hide when it staggers.
